traps.note: Count denoiser evaluations on both stacks per render; a mismatch makes the pair VOID (plan: H3 19 vs 20, LTX-2.3 8 vs 11, FLUX.3 base edit 50 vs 100).
Studio's 'max' speed tier auto-skips steps (static skip / FBCache, e.g. Qwen 25 -> ~13 computed); the default tier never skips. State the tier (settings SUMMARY A.5).
Pin DiT, TE and VAE precision on both stacks: Studio's auto picks (bf16-when-fits, hosted INT8 ConvRot) differ from the template files (settings SUMMARY B.7).

The baseline UI draws initial noise on the CPU (torch.manual_seed, bline/sample.py); Studio diffusers draws it with a GPU generator. Same seed != same noise: cross-stack LPIPS needs a shared CPU fp32 noise tensor, otherwise score each stack only against its own bf16 (h3_image.md #7; moss REPORT: 0.69 LPIPS across stacks on different samplers).
The baseline UI caches node outputs: every timed request carries a nonce (bline_graphs.apply_nonce) and must show an execution count > 0.
The template ships a prompt enhancer / upsampler; benchmarks switch it off on the baseline UI arm and send the raw prompt to both stacks.

CFG > 1: Studio may run cond + uncond as ONE batch-2 forward (diffusion_cfg_batch) where the baseline UI runs two; evaluation counts are per sample row, so a forward-call hook undercounts Studio by 2x (settings_audit_nov10/flux.md, 'Not verified').
Studio runs FLUX.3 bf16 when it fits; the template file is int8 ConvRot: pin the format (settings_audit_nov10/flux.md (b)2).
The subgraph's inner KSampler widget reads 15 / er_sde; the instance proxies 16 / euler / simple, which is what runs (an earlier graph used er_sde).
